meta.name: Cambridge IELTS test blueprints
meta.attribution: Derived from the question-group annotations published in the library/ directory of https://github.com/wanli4473/yysd-testcenter.
meta.note: Annotation metadata only. No passage text, question wording, answer key or audio is redistributed: the Cambridge IELTS papers are copyright Cambridge University Press & Assessment, and the upstream repository publishes no licence. The difficulty ratings are one annotator's judgement, not an official or psychometric measure.

types.note: The upstream vocabulary has one label for both identification tasks. Cambridge sets true/false/not given on factual passages and yes/no/not given on opinion passages; the annotation does not record which, so every group is reported as true-false-not-given.
One upstream label covers every gap-fill task. Cambridge distinguishes sentence, note, table, summary and form completion; the annotation does not, so every group is reported as sentence-completion.
Flow-chart completion has no separate canonical identifier and is reported as diagram-label-completion, the nearest visual-labelling family.
